steps.title: Initialize Simple Notes and Counter Project
steps.description: Set up the base directory structure and initialize project metadata.

steps.title: Create Android Manifest
steps.description: Configure the AndroidManifest.xml with application package, name, and main entry activity using standard Material design theme.

steps.title: Configure Gradle Build Script
steps.description: Set up build.gradle with correct SDK versions, Java 8 compatibility, and compilation targets without external dependencies.

steps.title: Design Main User Interface Layout
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml containing a clean, scrollable layout with standard UI elements for a counter and quick notes pad.

steps.title: Implement Counter Functionality
steps.description: Write counter logic in MainActivity.java to handle counting actions (increment, decrement, reset) and maintain state.

steps.title: Implement Persistent Note Storage
steps.description: Add SharedPreferences persistent storage integration to MainActivity.java to auto-save and retrieve notes.

steps.title: Set Up UI Event Listeners
steps.description: Define standard anonymous inner classes for button clicks to remain fully Java 8 compatible.

steps.title: Validate Icon Reference setup
steps.description: Verify the application is set to use the standard icon reference as per project specifications.

steps.title: Perform UI Layout & Text alignment checks
steps.description: Ensure views are structured logically with correct margins and text sizes for dynamic screen layouts.

steps.title: Building Simple Notes and Counter
steps.description: Execute the Gradle assembleDebug task to compile resources and generate the final build application package.
